name: aprovan
description: Connect to the Aprovan workspace MCP server — tool catalog, filesystem, telemetry, and workflows through the workspace gateway at /api/mcp.

APROVAN_MCP_URL.title: MCP endpoint URL
APROVAN_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP MCP URL for your workspace gateway (must end with /api/mcp).

APROVAN_MCP_TOKEN.title: Bearer token
APROVAN_MCP_TOKEN.description: Optional access token for hosted gateways with auth. Leave empty for local mode (auth off).
